title: Home-Site Lease Rent Ledger: Monthly Rent, Occupant Charges, Proration and Credits
content:
**How site rent is billed on the Home-Site Lease**

- Site rent is charged for each calendar month on the lot class's rent due day of that month, at the contracted monthly site rent on the lease that day.
- In the move-in month and in the month the lease ends, the rent is prorated on the lot class's proration basis — the monthly rent divided by the calendar days in that month, multiplied by the days occupied, the move-in day and the last day of occupancy both counted — and rounded half up to the cent.
- For each registered adult beyond the adults included in the site rent, an occupant charge of the lot class's monthly charge per further adult is posted for the same period and prorated the same way. An occupant change takes effect from the next billing period.
- The move-in concession of the lot class's concession percentage of the first full month's site rent is credited once, only on a twelve- or twenty-four-month lease, and never on occupant charges.
- A rent credit for a billing correction restores exactly the amount over-billed for that period and nothing else.
- Rent charges stop with the month the lease ends; no rent is charged for a month after the closed date.
- Rent and occupant charges are posted only while the lease is active, notice to vacate or in default, and for the final prorated month of a lease that has just closed. The lease status is read from the lease record of the lease being charged.

**Status and posting**

| Lease status | Rent and occupant charges posted |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| notice to vacate | yes |
| in default | yes |
| closed | only the final prorated month of a lease that has just closed |

**Worked move-in month (hypothetical)** — move-in on the 20th of a 30-day month; contracted rent 668.00; three registered adults where two are included and each further adult is 30.00 a month; a twelve-month lease on a lot class with a 25.0 percent concession.

| Entry | Computation in words | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Rent, move-in month | 668.00 divided by 30, multiplied by 11 days (the 20th through the 30th) | 244.93 |
| Occupant charge, move-in month | 30.00 for one further adult, divided by 30, multiplied by 11 | 11.00 |
| Concession, first full month | 25.0 percent of the first full month's rent of 668.00 | 167.00 credit |

The concession is taken on the first full month, not on the prorated move-in month, and is not applied to the 30.00 occupant charge.
